answers.quote: There shall be a Governor for each State
answers.notes: Art 153 claim directly states a Governor for each State.

answers.quote: shall be vested in the Governor and shall be exercised by him either directly or through officers subordinate to him in accordance with this Constitution
answers.notes: Art 154(1) claim vests State executive power in the Governor.

answers.quote: the same person as Governor for two or more States
answers.notes: Art 153 proviso claim covers same person as Governor of two or more States.

answers.answer: রাজ্যপাল ও কক্ষ বা কক্ষসমূহ নিয়ে
answers.quote: shall be a Legislature which shall consist of the Governor, and
answers.notes: Art 168(1) claim: Legislature consists of the Governor and the House(s).

answers.quote: The Governor of a State shall be appointed by the President by warrant under his hand and seal
answers.notes: Art 155 claim: Governor appointed by the President; also NCERT c46.

answers.quote: a Governor shall hold office for a term of five years from the date on which he enters upon his office: Provided that a Governor shall, notwithstanding the expiration of his term, continue to hold office until his successor enters upon his office
answers.notes: Art 156(3) claim: term of five years.

answers.quote: No person shall be eligible for appointment as Governor unless he is a citizen of India and has completed the age of thirty-five years
answers.notes: Art 157 claim: citizen of India and completed 35 years.

answers.quote: make and subscribe in the presence of the Chief Justice of the High Court exercising jurisdiction in relation to the State, or, in his absence, the senior most Judge of that Court available, an oath or affirmation
answers.notes: Art 159 claim: oath before Chief Justice of the High Court (or senior-most Judge if absent).

answers.quote: The Governor shall hold office during the pleasure of the President
answers.notes: Art 156(1) claim: holds office during pleasure of the President.

answers.quote: The Governor may, by writing under his hand addressed to the President, resign his office
answers.notes: Art 156(2) claim: resignation by writing addressed to the President.

answers.answer: তিনি অন্য কোনো লাভজনক পদ ধারণ করতে পারেন না
answers.quote: The Governor shall not hold any other office of profit
answers.notes: Art 158(2) claim: Governor shall not hold any other office of profit; other options contradict c09/c11.

answers.answer: তিনি উত্তরসূরি দায়িত্ব না নেওয়া পর্যন্ত পদে থেকে যাবেন
answers.quote: a Governor shall hold office for a term of five years from the date on which he enters upon his office: Provided that a Governor shall, notwithstanding the expiration of his term, continue to hold office until his successor enters upon his office
answers.notes: Art 156(3) proviso in claim: continues to hold office until successor enters office.

answers.answer: রাজ্যপাল হিসেবে দায়িত্ব নেওয়ার দিনেই আসনটি শূন্য বলে গণ্য হবে
answers.quote: The Governor shall not be a member of either House of Parliament or of a House of the Legislature of any State specified in the First Schedule, and if a member of either House of Parliament or of a House of the Legislature of any such State be appointed Governor, he shall be deemed to have vacated his seat in that House on the date on which he enters upon his office as Governor
answers.notes: Art 158(1) claim: deemed to have vacated seat on date he enters office as Governor.

answers.quote: There shall be a Council of Ministers with the Chief Minister at the head to aid and advise the Governor in the exercise of his functions, except in so far as he is by or under this Constitution required to exercise his functions or any of them in his discretion
answers.notes: Art 163(1) claim: Council of Ministers with Chief Minister at the head.

answers.quote: the decision of the Governor in his discretion shall be final, and the validity of anything done by the Governor shall not be called in question on the ground that he ought or ought not to have acted in his discretion
answers.notes: Art 163(2) claim: Governor decision on discretion is final.

answers.answer: কোনো আদালত এ নিয়ে তদন্ত করতে পারবে না
answers.quote: The question whether any, and if so what, advice was tendered by Ministers to the Governor shall not be inquired into in any court
answers.notes: Art 163(3) claim: advice tendered shall not be inquired into in any court.

answers.quote: The Chief Minister shall be appointed by the Governor and the other Ministers shall be appointed by the Governor on the advice of the Chief Minister, and the Ministers shall hold office during the pleasure of the Governor
answers.notes: Art 164(1) claim: Chief Minister appointed by the Governor.

answers.quote: The Council of Ministers shall be collectively responsible to the Legislative Assembly of the State
answers.notes: Art 164(2) claim: collectively responsible to the Legislative Assembly.

answers.answer: মন্ত্রিসভার সমস্ত সিদ্ধান্ত ও আইন-প্রস্তাব রাজ্যপালকে জানানো
answers.quote: to communicate to the Governor of the State all decisions of the Council of Ministers relating to the administration of the affairs of the State and proposals for legislation; (b) to furnish such information relating to the administration of the affairs of the State and proposals for legislation as the Governor may call for
answers.notes: Art 167 claim: CM must communicate all Council decisions and legislative proposals to the Governor.

answers.quote: All executive action of the Government of a State shall be expressed to be taken in the name of the Governor
answers.notes: Art 166(1) claim: executive action expressed in the name of the Governor.

answers.quote: it shall be presented to the Governor and the Governor shall declare either that he assents to the Bill or that he withholds assent therefrom or that he reserves the Bill for the consideration of the President
answers.notes: Claims state the Governor declares assent to a Bill under Art 200 (c31) and refer to an Act assented to by the Governor (c39); claims do not use the exact words "becomes law", hence LIKELY not SURE.

answers.quote: six months shall not intervene between its last sitting in one session and the date appointed for its first sitting in the next session
answers.notes: Art 174(1) claim: six months shall not intervene between sessions.

answers.quote: The Governor may from time to time— (a) prorogue the House or either House; (b) dissolve the Legislative Assembly
answers.notes: Art 174(2) claim: Governor may dissolve the Legislative Assembly (Council dissolution is not listed).

answers.answer: সাধারণ নির্বাচনের পর প্রথম অধিবেশনে ও প্রতি বছরের প্রথম অধিবেশনে
answers.quote: At the commencement of the first session after each general election to the Legislative Assembly and at the commencement of the first session of each year, the Governor shall address the Legislative Assembly or, in the case of a State having a Legislative Council, both Houses assembled together and inform the Legislature of the causes of its summons
answers.notes: Art 176(1) claim: address at first session after each general election and first session of each year.

answers.answer: বিলটি নিজে সংশোধন করে আইনে পরিণত করা
answers.quote: it shall be presented to the Governor and the Governor shall declare either that he assents to the Bill or that he withholds assent therefrom or that he reserves the Bill for the consideration of the President
answers.notes: Art 200 claims (c31, c32) enumerate assent, withholding, reservation and return; amending the Bill himself is not among the Governor powers in the claims.

answers.quote: if the Bill is passed again by the House or Houses with or without amendment and presented to the Governor for assent, the Governor shall not withhold assent therefrom
answers.notes: Art 200 claim: if Bill passed again, Governor shall not withhold assent.

answers.quote: the Governor may, as soon as possible after the presentation to him of the Bill for assent, return the Bill if it is not a Money Bill together with a message requesting that the House or Houses will reconsider the Bill
answers.notes: Art 200 first proviso claim: return applies only if it is not a Money Bill.

answers.quote: The Governor shall in respect of every financial year cause to be laid before the House or Houses of the Legislature of the State a statement of the estimated receipts and expenditure of the State for that year, in this Part referred to as the “annual financial statement”
answers.notes: Art 202(1) claim: Governor shall cause the annual financial statement to be laid.

answers.answer: রাজ্যপালের সুপারিশ ছাড়া আনা যাবে না, এবং বিধান পরিষদে আনা যাবে না
answers.quote: A Bill or amendment making provision for any of the matters specified in sub-clauses (a) to (f) of clause (1) of article 199 shall not be introduced or moved except on the recommendation of the Governor, and a Bill making such provision shall not be introduced in a Legislative Council
answers.notes: Art 207(1) claim matches both conditions: Governor recommendation required and no introduction in Legislative Council.

answers.answer: নিজে সম্মতি না দিয়ে রাষ্ট্রপতির বিবেচনার জন্য সংরক্ষণ করতে হবে
answers.quote: the Governor shall not assent to, but shall reserve for the consideration of the President, any Bill which in the opinion of the Governor would, if it became law, so derogate from the powers of the High Court as to endanger the position which that Court is by this Constitution designed to fill
answers.notes: Art 200 second proviso claim: shall not assent but shall reserve such a Bill for the President.

answers.answer: আইনসভা অধিবেশনে না থাকলে ও তাৎক্ষণিক ব্যবস্থা জরুরি হলে
answers.quote: If at any time, except when the Legislative Assembly of a State is in session, or where there is a Legislative Council in a State, except when both Houses of the Legislature are in session, the Governor is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary for him to take immediate action, he may promulgate such Ordinances as the circumstances appear to him to require
answers.notes: Art 213(1) claim: Legislature not in session and immediate action necessary.

answers.quote: shall cease to operate at the expiration of six weeks from the reassembly of the Legislature, or if before the expiration of that period a resolution disapproving it is passed by the Legislative Assembly and agreed to by the Legislative Council, if any
answers.notes: Art 213(2)(a) claim: Ordinance ceases six weeks from reassembly (or earlier if disapproved).

answers.answer: যেসব বিষয়ে রাজ্যের শাসনক্ষমতা বিস্তৃত, সেই বিষয়ের আইন পর্যন্ত
answers.quote: The Governor of a State shall have the power to grant pardons, reprieves, respites or remissions of punishment or to suspend, remit or commute the sentence of any person convicted of any offence against any law relating to a matter to which the executive power of the State extends
answers.notes: Art 161 claim limits pardon power to offences against laws on matters within State executive power.

answers.answer: রাজ্যপালের সম্মতিপ্রাপ্ত রাজ্য আইনসভার আইনের সমান
answers.quote: An Ordinance promulgated under this article shall have the same force and effect as an Act of the Legislature of the State assented to by the Governor
answers.notes: Art 213(2) claim: same force and effect as an Act of the State Legislature assented to by the Governor.

answers.answer: যেসব বিষয়ে রাজ্য আইনসভা আইন করতে পারে, সেসব বিষয়েই রাজ্যের শাসনক্ষমতা বিস্তৃত
answers.quote: the executive power of a State shall extend to the matters with respect to which the Legislature of the State has power to make laws
answers.notes: Art 162 claim: executive power extends to matters the State Legislature can make laws on.

answers.quote: The Governor of each State shall appoint a person who is qualified to be appointed a Judge of a High Court to be Advocate-General for the State
answers.notes: Art 165(1) claim: Governor appoints the Advocate-General.

answers.quote: the posting and promotion of, district judges in any State shall be made by the Governor of the State in consultation with the High Court exercising jurisdiction in relation to such State
answers.notes: Art 233(1) claim: district judges appointed by Governor in consultation with the High Court.

answers.quote: The Chairman and other members of a Public Service Commission shall be appointed, in the case of the Union Commission or a Joint Commission, by the President, and in the case of a State Commission, by the Governor of the State
answers.notes: Art 316(1) claim: State Commission Chairman and members appointed by the Governor.

answers.quote: the Chairman or any other member of a Public Service Commission shall only be removed from his office by order of the President on the ground of misbehaviour after the Supreme Court, on reference being made to it by the President, has, on inquiry held in accordance with the procedure prescribed in that behalf under article 145, reported that the Chairman or such other member, as the case may be, ought on any such ground to be removed
answers.notes: Art 317(1) claim: removal only by the President after Supreme Court inquiry reports misbehaviour.

answers.quote: If the President, on receipt of a report from the Governor of a State or otherwise, is satisfied that a situation has arisen in which the Government of the State cannot be carried on in accordance with the provisions of this Constitution, the President may by Proclamation
answers.notes: Art 356(1) claim: President acts on receipt of a report from the Governor (or otherwise).

answers.quote: There shall be a Council of Ministers with the Chief Minister at the head to aid and advise the Governor in the exercise of his functions, except in so far as he is by or under this Constitution required to exercise his functions or any of them in his discretion
answers.notes: Statement 1 follows c16 (aid and advice except discretion); Statement 2 contradicts c18 (no court inquiry into advice), so only Statement 1 is correct.

answers.quote: The Governor of a State shall be appointed by the President by warrant under his hand and seal
answers.notes: A=Art 155 appointment (c04), B=Art 161 pardons (c14), C=Art 213 Ordinances (c38), D=Art 163 aid/advice and discretion (c16): A-2, B-1, C-4, D-3.

answers.answer: A ও R উভয়ই সঠিক এবং R হল A-এর সঠিক ব্যাখ্যা
answers.quote: The Governor shall hold office during the pleasure of the President
answers.notes: A follows c06 (five-year term) read with c05; R (pleasure of the President, c05) is true and explains why office can end earlier.

answers.quote: If at any time, except when the Legislative Assembly of a State is in session, or where there is a Legislative Council in a State, except when both Houses of the Legislature are in session, the Governor is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary for him to take immediate action, he may promulgate such Ordinances as the circumstances appear to him to require
answers.notes: 213-Ordinance pair matches c38; other pairs contradict claims: 159 is oath (c12), 201 is President on reserved Bills (c35), 165 is Advocate-General (c22).

answers.quote: it shall be presented to the Governor and the Governor shall declare either that he assents to the Bill or that he withholds assent therefrom or that he reserves the Bill for the consideration of the President
answers.notes: Statement 1 follows c31 (reservation power); Statement 2 contradicts c32 (Money Bills cannot be returned), so only Statement 1 is correct.
